fib: ______ is the economic cost or real cost of producing a specified quantity of a product.
Opportunity cost
Opportunity cost is the economic cost or real cost of producing a specified quantity of a product.
______ is an agrarian nation going by the singular contributions of this sector to the country's socio-economic development.
Nigeria
Nigeria is an agrarian nation going by the singular contributions of this sector to the country's socio-economic development.
______ is defined as: Y = f(X1, X2/ X3, X4… Xn).
implicit functional form
The implicit functional form is defined as: Y = f(X1, X2/ X3, X4… Xn).
______ is the application of economic principles to the operations of the agricultural industry.
Agricultural economics
Agricultural economics is the application of economic principles to the operations of the agricultural industry.
______ is a mathematical relationship between the total cost of production and the output produced.
cost function
Cost Functions A cost function is a mathematical relationship between the total cost of production and the output produced.
______ is the first derivative of the Total cost function, that is, MC = dTC / dY.
exact marginal cost
The exact marginal cost is the first derivative of the Total cost function, that is, MC = dTC / dY.
______ is a technical relationship between inputs and output.
production function
The production function is a technical relationship between inputs and output.
______ is a function of the economically active proportion of the population released for agricultural activities.
Labour availability
Labour availability is a function of the economically active proportion of the population released for agricultural activities.
